question: 上个月全院出院人次是多少
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(visit_id) AS ip_discharge_cnt FROM dwd_fact_inpatient_discharge WHERE discharge_date >= '2026-09-01' AND discharge_date < '2026-10-01'

question: 门诊量多少
time_expr: 上月（默认最近一个完整月）
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(is_valid_visit) AS op_visit_cnt FROM dwd_fact_outpatient_visit WHERE visit_date >= '2026-09-01' AND visit_date < '2026-10-01' AND is_valid_visit = 1
notes: 门诊量有歧义：人次/人数、挂号/有效就诊。澄清后按有效就诊人次
